difficulty_reason: The proof retains both the iterated-fiber equivalences and the truncation exactness argument, with sign compatibility. These make an H2 construction beyond applying a known long exact sequence.

compared.difference: Existing Freudenthal establishes connectivity of the suspension map and uses group consequences only as uncounted background. This constructs the long exact sequence for an arbitrary pointed map.
Hypercubical manifolds concerns a different cubical presentation, not this book claim.
A Whitehead result for test categories has different objects and hypotheses; not this finitely truncated type theorem.
